# Builds Syphon-Framework (fetched into ${syphon_SOURCE_DIR}) as a static
# library, because the upstream build needs Xcode (xcodebuild + the offline
# `metal` compiler), and we only have the Command Line Tools.
#
# Differences from the upstream Xcode build:
#  * Static library instead of Syphon.framework; headers are exposed as
#    <Syphon/...> through a symlinked include directory.
#  * SyphonServerRendererMetal.m is replaced by ./SyphonServerRendererMetal.m,
#    which compiles SyphonMetalShaders.metal from source at runtime
#    (upstream loads a precompiled default.metallib from the framework bundle,
#    which we cannot build). The shader source is embedded at build time.

set(SYPHON_DIR "${syphon_SOURCE_DIR}")

file(GLOB SYPHON_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${SYPHON_DIR}/*.m" "${SYPHON_DIR}/*.c")
list(REMOVE_ITEM SYPHON_SOURCES "${SYPHON_DIR}/SyphonServerRendererMetal.m")
list(APPEND SYPHON_SOURCES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/SyphonServerRendererMetal.m")

# <Syphon/Foo.h> -> ${SYPHON_DIR}/Foo.h. A symlink (not a copy) so that
# #import "Foo.h" and #import <Syphon/Foo.h> resolve to the same file.
set(SYPHON_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${SYPHON_INCLUDE_DIR}")
if(NOT EXISTS "${SYPHON_INCLUDE_DIR}/Syphon")
    file(CREATE_LINK "${SYPHON_DIR}" "${SYPHON_INCLUDE_DIR}/Syphon" SYMBOLIC)
endif()

# Embed the Metal shader source (with its #include inlined, since runtime
# compilation cannot resolve includes) as a NUL-terminated byte array.
set(_metal_src   "${SYPHON_DIR}/SyphonMetalShaders.metal")
set(_metal_types "${SYPHON_DIR}/SyphonServerMetalTypes.h")
set(_gen_header  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/SyphonMetalShaderSource.h")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${_metal_src}" "${_metal_types}")
file(READ "${_metal_src}" _src)
file(READ "${_metal_types}" _types)
string(REPLACE "#include \"SyphonServerMetalTypes.h\"" "${_types}" _src "${_src}")
string(HEX "${_src}" _hex)
string(REGEX REPLACE "([0-9a-f][0-9a-f])" "0x\\1," _hex "${_hex}")
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${_gen_header}" CONTENT
"// Generated by third_party/syphon/CMakeLists.txt from SyphonMetalShaders.metal. Do not edit.
static const char kSyphonMetalShaderSource[] = { ${_hex} 0x00 };
")

add_library(syphon STATIC ${SYPHON_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(syphon
    PUBLIC  "${SYPHON_INCLUDE_DIR}"
    PRIVATE "${SYPHON_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
target_compile_definitions(syphon PRIVATE SYPHON_CORE_SHARE)
target_compile_options(syphon PRIVATE
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:OBJC>:-fobjc-arc>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:OBJC>:SHELL:-include ${SYPHON_DIR}/Syphon_Prefix.pch>"
    -w  # third-party code: silence (mostly OpenGL deprecation) warnings
)
set_target_properties(syphon PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_EXTENSIONS ON)
target_link_libraries(syphon PUBLIC
    "-framework Foundation" "-framework Cocoa" "-framework IOSurface"
    "-framework Metal" "-framework OpenGL" "-framework CoreVideo")
